title: Preview budget: one round per task plus one final, 30 min per child, slow shards once, schema-shard routing fixed, host kept awake during gates

outcomes.statement: The tenant preview-budget contract is delivered: WORK_READINESS.md §Per-task mutation previews budgets one preview round per implementation task after its focused tests are green plus one round after the final fix wave, with a target of <= 30 preview_minutes per child, and requires a named closure root_cause reason for any round beyond tasks + 1 or minutes beyond 30; it previews a shard whose last run exceeded 5 minutes once per child at the final round unless a fix touched its sources; and it replaces 'repair every genuine survivor and rerun its affected preview before task review' with: a survivor found by a preview joins the next fix round. §Session shape states the wait shape once, next to 'Never poll at 1 s': launch a preview round in the background, start the next task's RED/GREEN, collect at that task's review boundary. §Commands documents the local gate invocation under caffeinate -i (macOS) or systemd-inhibit (Linux), and the §Closure template requires any gate run above 2x the median wall time to be recorded with its cause. docs/dev-guide/local/CLAUDE.md §Verification cost carries the short form. No heading is added or renamed, so the AGENTS.md link stays valid.
outcomes.demo: Read WORK_READINESS.md §Per-task mutation previews, §Session shape, §Closure template and §Commands, and docs/dev-guide/local/CLAUDE.md §Verification cost; pnpm check:generated-guidance and pnpm lint exit 0.

outcomes.statement: Schema-shard routing no longer reports a preview that measures nothing as clean: when the diff contains a committed migration under packages/db/src/migrations/ and schema.ts carries mutants, the schema-static shard selects the mutation-compatible packages/db real-DB integration tests in the diff, and its Stryker command runs exactly the shard's testFiles instead of a hardcoded schema.test.ts; when no such integration test exists, preflight emits a named, non-fatal routing gap in its JSON and on stderr. Diffs without a migration keep byte-identical shard output.
outcomes.demo: pnpm test:mutation-scope: the US-071 Task 2 fixture (bd0397b paths: schema.ts, V20261006131500__analytics_cost_revisions.sql, analytics-ingestion.ts, analytics-ingestion.integration.test.ts, verify-schema.mjs) fails against the unmodified routing (testFiles == [schema.test.ts]) and passes with the new routing (integration test selected and present in the command); the same diff without the integration test reports the gap.

outcomes.statement: check:generated-guidance is green again: one registered CHG-069/84ab8ea overlay layer binds the two pinned guidance files drifted by US-070/071 (docs/dev-guide/TESTING.md and testing/critical-paths.md, edited in bd151bd, bc76f0c and ee321ff without a layer) from their latest pinned CHG-065/7817e94 bytes to the delivered bytes on main 84ab8ea; the reviewed reconciler digest is re-pinned in scripts/work-readiness/git.mjs; the pinned files themselves are not edited.
outcomes.demo: pnpm check:generated-guidance exits 0; python3 -m unittest infra/scripts/tests/test_reconcile_sprint1_docs.py passes with a CHG-069 manifest test; pnpm test:work-readiness passes the reconciler-digest assertion; node scripts/work-readiness.mjs check-range main HEAD passes.

uncertainties.statement: The schema-static shard's testFiles is metadata only: its Stryker commandRunner.command is hardcoded to src/schema.test.ts, so adding the integration test to testFiles alone would still score 0 of N.
uncertainties.resolution: The command is derived from spec.testFiles (paths relative to packages/db), so a selected integration test actually runs; the RED fixture asserts the command, not only testFiles. The shard is already database-backed (its source is under packages/db/), so no new runtime-profile path is introduced.

uncertainties.statement: 'Declares schema or migration changes' could mean the readiness signal or the diff.
uncertainties.resolution: The trigger is diff-based: a changed path under packages/db/src/migrations/ while schema.ts carries mutants. It is deterministic, needs no artifact read, and the RED fixture is a pure discoverMutationShardSummaries call with no Docker. MUTATION_INCOMPATIBLE_TESTS are never selected. A missing oracle is a named non-fatal gap, following the shard-count-mismatch convention (reported, never rejected).

uncertainties.statement: scripts/mutation-scope.mjs is a MUTATION_RUNNER_STATIC_INPUTS member, so editing it changes every shard's evidence fingerprint and makes cached previews stale.
uncertainties.resolution: Accepted: US-070/071 are dev_done and no child is in flight on main; the next child previews cold once. Budgeted in integration for re-running pnpm test:mutation-scope and test:mutation-evidence.

uncertainties.statement: Item 5 could be met by changing scripts.check, but CI does not run on darwin.
uncertainties.resolution: scripts.check is unchanged; WORK_READINESS.md §Commands documents caffeinate -i pnpm check on macOS and systemd-inhibit --what=idle:sleep pnpm check on Linux as the local gate invocation.

uncertainties.statement: The CHG body names 'pnpm lint (check:generated-guidance)', but check:generated-guidance is not part of pnpm lint.
uncertainties.resolution: Both are verified separately: pnpm lint and pnpm check:generated-guidance must each exit 0, plus pnpm test:mutation-scope for the item 4 fixture.

uncertainties.statement: The measured targets (preview_rounds <= tasks + 1, preview_minutes <= 30, focused_verification <= 30 %, one campaign, no host-sleep gate run) are observed on the next child, not inside CHG-069.
uncertainties.resolution: CHG-069 closes on the validation it can run now (test:work-readiness, test:mutation-scope, lint, check:generated-guidance, readiness:check CHG-069, one mutation:preflight, one pnpm check under caffeinate -i); the measured targets are Nous's to read on the next child.

uncertainties.statement: check:generated-guidance was already red on main 84ab8ea: US-070/071 edited the pinned TESTING.md and testing/critical-paths.md without registering an overlay layer, so CHG-069's acceptance check cannot pass without a re-pin.
uncertainties.resolution: Francisco ruled (2026-10-06 operator session) to re-pin inside CHG-069 rather than defer: one CHG-069/84ab8ea layer (reconciler spec, manifest, two desired files, reconciler test, REVIEWED_RECONCILER_SHA256 re-pin) in one commit; no pinned file is edited, so exactOverlayOwns parent-tree ownership is not exercised. The stale page-wiring fixture that keeps pnpm test:mutation-scope red on main (test-mutation-scope.mjs:1075) stays out of scope and is recorded as a deviation for a follow-up CHG; the item 4 block runs before it.

actuals.root_cause: Wall-clock from commit times and the CHG-069 phase markers, rounded up per bucket; the ~4.4 h wait for Francisco's reassessment approval (20:20Z to 00:45Z) is excluded as idle. readiness = orientation from ~19:58Z to the started event 20:13Z (15) plus the reassessment for the guidance re-pin ruling (2). implementation = 20:14Z to 20:20Z (routing with RED/GREEN, contract text) plus the overlay layer 00:45Z to 00:48Z. focused_verification = preflight against main (0 shards) and caffeinate -i pnpm check (~2 s wall, turbo cache replay). review = reviewer verdicts and one fix loop (4086295). integration = rechecks and closure. Below estimate because the routing fix was one helper plus a command derived from testFiles and the re-pin followed the CHG-065 layer shape exactly. Pre-existing on main and recorded: test:mutation-scope red at a stale page-wiring fixture (follow-up CHG), and test:feedback-order red on older US-026/US-071 lines. No previews: zero shards, no whole-set re-preview, no cold campaign, no test_report; no gate run exceeded 2x the median.
